A.name: Ground truth provenance
details: All 24 CSVs contain the same 591 official query records in manifest order. Identity, camera and scene were independently parsed from all 2678 train/query/gallery filenames and checked against the manifest.

The 1032 train records and 591 query/1055 gallery records have disjoint training/evaluation identities. All 14184 CSV rows have dataset-derived relevant-gallery and kept-gallery counts under same-ID/same-scene exclusion.

All per-query INP values equal the independently counted relevant-gallery size divided by saved last-match rank. Rank-1/5/10/20 are recomputed from saved first-match rank. No model-output-generated label or reference was found.

Installed dataset files and raw distance matrices were deliberately not reopened. Historical installed-GT proofs are reused only as recorded in AH result.json and R independent_cpu_audit.json. This verifies saved evidence, not a new independent ranking run.

B.name: Score normalization
details: Six metrics are 100 times arithmetic means across all 591 valid queries. Cohort AP/INP means use the explicit cohort size. No metric divides by a maximum, minimum or mean of its own predictions.
Per-query AP divides cumulative precision at GT-relevant ranks by the GT-relevant count; INP divides that count by the last relevant rank. 100 is a percent conversion.
Feature L2 normalization precedes distance computation in the historical outlet evaluator. This is descriptor normalization for ranking, not rescaling reported performance by model output statistics.
Independent 50-digit Decimal sums differ from current six-metric CSV and JSON by at most 7.105427357601002e-15 percentage points.

E.name: Honest scope and claim limits
details: The artifact honestly states saved MSVR310 normal-input coverage only, no new neural calls, optimizer updates, weights, selected model or missing-modality evaluation.

This is one dataset, official query3 with 591 queries from 52 identities, 8 cameras and 30 scenes, one recorded seed42. Twenty-four rows are descriptors/states across several historical models; they are not 24 independently trained experiments.

R frequency/axis use separately trained fixed selected checkpoints at epochs1/3; AH frequency/axis states use separately trained fixed checkpoints at epochs32/29. Within each model, outlet/state comparisons observe the same fixed checkpoint; cross-R/AH/strong comparisons also differ in training, teacher, interface and descriptor dimension.

Benchmark-mAP-best selection is expressly disclosed. This is not an untouched-test generalization estimate, a multi-seed result, a missing-modality result, a new +1 target claim or a matched causal ablation of a module.

Cohorts use GT and observed correctness after evaluation. Correct-on-error overlap gives offline complementarity, not an inference-time selector or demonstrated trained decoder gain. Rescue counts must retain the paired harm counts.
